maps.name: OCCURRENCE-OWNER
maps.forward: Exact per-format Entry spelling -> owner_is_function=false,function=0; exact per-format Function payload i -> true,i. Integer i is retained exactly, including 0.
maps.inverse: false,0 -> that format's exact Entry spelling; true,i -> that format's exact Function spelling with i. false with nonzero has no inverse and remains an actual mismatch. Unknown/unpinned spelling or extra key is a gap, never a fallback.
maps.domain: The source-fixed inactive function column is justified by this exact disposition; actual function field must independently be present and compared. Scalar schema has no Function variant.

maps.name: EVENT-OUTCOME-PAYLOAD
maps.forward: Separate explicit outcomeTag in Running/Halted/Exhausted chooses the exact per-format Running inactive unit or exact active value/reason object. Only Fuel has a literal reason spelling. Rejected and other reason names remain explicit unrepresented format gaps.
maps.inverse: Tagged Running restores the exact format inactive literal and separate Running tag. Halted restores exact Ref tag/id; Exhausted Fuel restores the exact reason string. Rejected and other reasons have no reviewed O spelling and remain typed actual differences/gaps. Both actual outcome_tag and payload discriminator compare independently.
maps.domain: No missing payload becomes integer0 or null; no active integer is treated as absent; reason names use the pinned closed unit enum declaration.

maps.name: EVENT-SOURCE-OCCURRENCE
maps.forward: Pinned literal annotation, or original sourceOf(e) expansion from the exact named expected companion occurrence row and occurrencePaths slice, -> complete Occurrence locator. Annotation programSourceDigest compares separately at actual event.step_id.run_id.identity.program_membership_digest under the original formula.
maps.inverse: Given the compared full program view, explicit event source_expr_id e, full Occurrence locator, and declared identity digest carrier, reconstruct the exact format annotation/row+slice reference. Owner uses its format inverse; ast_path preserves every integer/order/duplicate. The sourceReference annotation is not an extra Locator digest field.
maps.domain: This is a bijection of the full compared envelope plus declared reference relation, not of an isolated locator with erased companion. Unselected binds nothing. Wrong source_expr_id, row, slice, path, digest carrier, Table/Field variant, extra key or missing carrier remains a difference/gap. Never search by equality, infer from expressions or derive execution. Only Unselected digest has a reviewed source spelling; Selected remains a named gap.

preserved: Every unmatched expected/actual atom stays visible. Complete observation arrays and arena entries remain ordered and distinct; no helper erasure or common-subset comparison. JSON object member order is not a byte-codec claim.

unrepresentedLiteralDomain.disposition: named GAP, never defaulted; unexpected actual typed values remain complete differences

provenanceScope: Case-free public mapping domains only; no private oracle input or case/fuel membership included.
profileCarrier: PROFILE-ID-TRANSPORT.json explicit three-code bijection; raw singular wire provenance + independent inverse/currentB comparison mandatory
